song.name: Torn from the Stars
song.plot: The Great Rift is torn open — Vorgos tears reality to pull Anya from Auroria at the moment of Nyktoros's awakening. Anya, a scholar in the Crystal Sanctum, is wrenched from Auroria and falls through the Rift into the abyss. The album's cliffhanger finale, ending mid-fall into The Paradox of Light.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Anya, first person — the album's cliffhanger finale; her introduction. Anchors: the Crystal Sanctum (Anya's origin, Auroria), the Great Rift, the torn sky, falling, the Underworld below, her Aurorian home receding. Anya named. No landing (next album), no Valen, no Seraphina, no Underworld ground, no fight — ends mid-fall. Anya's POV should not vilify Vorgos beyond the fact of the abduction — horror at the abduction plus a hint of design. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro (the fall). Slow build then a dramatic drop. Suggested Suno direction: soaring then falling — ethereal verse over cosmic strings, a drop/descent in the final bars, unresolved (cliffhanger).

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: I was reading in the Sanctum of my home, When the sky above Auroria tore in two. A hand of storm came down and drew me through, And the stars began to fall away.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Torn from the stars, I am falling, Through the Great Rift's endless wound. Auroria's light is receding, And I am swallowed by the gloom.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: Anya — that was all I ever was, A scholar of the light and of the deep. Now the abyss is rising up to claim, The only world I knew how to keep.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Torn from the stars, I am falling, Through the Great Rift's endless wound. Auroria's light is receding, And I am swallowed by the gloom.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: Was this design, or cruel chance? Some force has taken me in hand. I cannot see the land below, Only the dark, and what was planned.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Torn from the stars, I am falling, Through the Great Rift's endless wound. Auroria's light is receding, And I am swallowed by the gloom.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: Falling... falling... Through the dark, toward the Underworld below... Falling...
